caption: A clear plastic container with rounded corners rests on a white circular surface, holding a single irregular chunk of white crystalline material on a ribbed base. A translucent grayish lobe sits at the chunk's lower right, a few dark specks dot its surface, and small white droplets cling to the base beside it. The mass's outline shifts subtly, its top edge growing more broken and peaked while its sides widen marginally, leaving the solid looking slightly larger and fluffier. The lower-right lobe persists as its border drifts with the rest of the body. The container stays essentially fixed against the disc, with only minor apparent shifts of the seat ellipse and background edges consistent with small handheld camera drift. No splitting, rotation, or disappearance of the chunk is visible.
